commentary_title: VLGC tonne-mile demand rises despite subdued spot market activity
commentary_summary: Drewry’s tonne-mile index rose further from the previous week, indicating increasing share of laden VLGCs in both the East and West. | Spot market activity remained subdued as weak Asian buying interest limited enquiries and fixtures. | Meanwhile, stronger Middle East demand tightened Atlantic vessel availability and brought additional July US Gulf cargoes to market. | Freight rates in the East continued to command a strong premium over ex- US Gulf routes, supported by robust Middle East loading activity. | Meanwhile, regional oil companies increasingly used their own vessels for Strait of Hormuz transits.
